name: tick
description: Standard game-loop function tag. Every function registered in this tag is executed by the server once every game tick (20 times per second / 20 Hz). Used for continuous polling, timer countdowns, continuous player checks, and state machine transitions.
execution_context: Server-level global context with @s unset. Functions needing player context should use 'execute as @a at @s run ...'.

schema.values: Required list of namespaced function identifiers (e.g. ['custom_pack:tick']) or subtags (e.g. ['#custom_pack:subtick']). Entries may also be objects with 'id' and 'required'.
schema.replace: Optional boolean. Defaults to false when omitted. When false (the standard default), this datapack's entries are appended to existing entries from other datapacks. When true, all entries from lower-priority datapacks for this tag are discarded.

best_practices: Omit 'replace' by default so Minecraft uses the default append behavior (replace: false).
Always namespace functions explicitly (e.g. 'my_pack:tick', never bare 'tick').
Never generate this tag under a custom namespace (e.g. 'data/my_pack/tags/function/tick.json') expecting automatic execution, because Minecraft ONLY executes #minecraft:tick automatically.
Ensure all referenced functions exist on disk. In Minecraft Java 1.21+, if even one required function reference is missing, Mojang's TagLoader discards the entire tag.

name: load
description: Standard initialization function tag. Every function registered in this tag is executed once when the world loads or when the /reload command is executed. Used for initializing scoreboard objectives, setting up default values for global state holders (fake players like #global), and printing load diagnostics.
execution_rate: Once on world load and on /reload
execution_context: Server startup context when 0 players are connected. Player selectors (@a, @p, @r) match 0 entities. All initialization must use fake player names (e.g. '#global').

schema.values: Required list of namespaced function identifiers (e.g. ['custom_pack:load']) or subtags. Entries may also be objects with 'id' and 'required'.
schema.replace: Optional boolean. Defaults to false when omitted. When false, appends to other datapacks. When true, overwrites lower-priority datapacks.

best_practices: Omit 'replace' by default to allow cooperative loading alongside other datapacks.
Do not use player selectors (@a, @p) in load functions; use fake players (e.g. '#global', '#load_ran').
Ensure all referenced functions exist on disk to prevent TagLoader dropping the tag.
